recipes.name: Hazelnut coffee roll
sentences: Grease a 25cm x 30cm Swiss roll pan, line base and sides with paper, grease paper well.
Combine eggs and sugar in medium bowl, beat with electric mixer for about 10 minutes or until sugar is dissolved and mixture is thick and creamy.
Pour into prepared pan, bake in moderate oven for about 12 minutes.
Trim crisp edges from cake, roll up in paper from the long side, stand 2 minutes, unroll, cool.

recipes.name: Pork parmigiana bake
ingredients: 1/3 cup loosely packed fresh cress or baby basil leaves
sentences: Spray eggplant on both sides with cooking oil; cook on a heated grill plate (or grill or barbecue) over high heat for 2 minutes on each side or until browned and tender.
Grill for about 3 minutes or until prosciutto is browned and crisp.
Meanwhile, heat half the oil in a shallow 2-litre (8-cup) flameproof baking dish over medium-high heat.
Season pork; cook for 1 minute on each side or until almost cooked.
Place baking dish under grill; cook for about 3 minutes or until bocconcini melts and pork is cooked through.

recipes.name: Chocolate cookie ice-cream
ingredients: 100 gram dark eating chocolate, chopped finely
100 gram dark eating chocolate, chopped coarsely

recipes.name: Gluten free chicken nuggets with spicy aïoli dipping sauce
sentences: Preheat a 5.3-litre air fryer to 180°C for 3 minutes.
Keep temperature set at 180°C; set timer for 8 minutes.

recipes.name: Boiled or steamed pudding (three-in-one fruit mix)
ingredients: 4 1/4 cup three-in-one fruit mix [(three-in-one fruit mix recipe)](https://www.womensweeklyfood.com.au/recipes/three-in-one-christmas-cake-mix-6926|target="_blank")
sentences: Have ready 2.5 metres (8 feet) of kitchen string and an extra ¾ cup (110g) plain flour.
Wearing rubber gloves, dip prepared pudding cloth  into boiling water; boil for 1 minute.

Working quickly, spread hot cloth on bench, rub extra flour into centre of cloth to cover an area of about 40cm (16 inches) in diameter, leave flour a little thicker in centre of cloth where "skin" on pudding will need to be thickest.
Cover boiler with a tight-fitting lid, boil rapidly for 5 hours.
If pudding has been cooked correctly, cloth will start to dry in patches within a few minutes; hang pudding for 10 minutes.
Stand at least 20 minutes or until skin darkens and pudding becomes firm before cutting to serve.
Steamed Pudding - Grease 2-litre (8-cup) pudding steamer, line base with baking paper.
Place a 30cm x 40cm (12-inch x 16-inch) sheet of foil on bench, grease foil, top with a sheet of baking paper.
Fold a 5cm (2-inch) pleat crossways through centre of both sheets.
Cover boiler with tight-fitting lid, steam 5 hours.
Stand pudding for 15 minutes before turning onto plate.
TO DEFROST PUDDING Thaw frozen pudding for 2 days in the refrigerator.
Remove from refrigerator 12 hours before reheating.
Boil for 2 hours following cooking instructions.
Steam for 2 hours following the cooking instructions.
TO MICROWAVE To reheat the whole pudding, cover with microwave-safe plastic wrap; microwave on MEDIUM (50%) for about 15 minutes.
To reheat four single serves at once, place on a microwave-safe plate, cover with microwave-safe plastic wrap; microwave on HIGH (100%) for about 3 minutes.

recipes.name: Cauliflower tortillas with pulled pork
ingredients: 1.2 kilogram boneless pork shoulder, rind removed
400 gram canned diced tomatoes, chopped finely
1 cup loosely packed fresh coriander leaves
sentences: Cook onion, oregano, bay leaves and garlic, stirring, for 5 minutes or until soft.
Stir in paste; cook, stirring, for 1 minute.
Reduce heat to low; simmer, covered, for 2½ hours or until pork is starting to fall apart, turning pork over in sauce occasionally.
Meanwhile, make the cauliflower tortillas: Preheat oven to 200°C/180°C fan.
Steam or microwave cauliflower, in two batches, for 3 minutes or until tender.
Divide mixture into 18 equal portions.
Mark two 13cm rounds on paper; turn paper over.
Spread cauliflower portions in rounds on trays; bake for 8 minutes.
Carefully turn tortillas over using a spatula; bake for a further 8 minutes or until browned around the edges.
Repeat with remaining cauliflower mixture to make 18 tortillas in total.

recipes.name: Florentine biscotti
ingredients: 1/2 cup (100 grams) red glacé cherries, halved
sentences: Preheat oven to 180°C.
Shape dough into two 30cm logs.
Bake about 30 minutes.
Reduce oven temperature to 140°C.
Using a serrated knife, slice logs diagonally into 5mm slices.
Bake about 15 minutes, turning halfway through baking, or until dry and crisp.
Place over a medium saucepan of simmering water (don't let water touch base of bowl); stir until chocolate is melted.

recipes.name: Orange cupcake bouquet
sentences: Cut each orange slice into 20 tiny wedges.
Preheat oven to 180°C/160°C fan-forced.
Line two 12-hole mini (1 tablespoon/20ml) muffin pans with paper cases.
Bake cakes about 15 minutes.

recipes.name: Pearl couscous ‘kedgeree’
ingredients: ½ bunch fresh coriander (cilantro), roots and stems washed, leaves picked
4 cm piece fresh ginger, grated finely
1 cup (250ml) chicken or vegetable stock (see tip)
sentences: Reserve 2 tablespoons coriander leaves to serve.
Coarsely chop remaining coriander leaves and finely chop roots and stems; you will need ½ cup firmly packed chopped leaves and 2 tablespoons finely chopped stems and roots.
Bring to the boil; cook for 3 minutes for soft-boiled.
If your choice of protein is chicken, cook for 6 minutes on each side or until golden and cooked through; transfer to a plate.
Cook coriander roots and stems, onion, garlic, ginger and bay leaf in same pan for 4 minutes or until onion softens.
Stir in curry powder; cook for 1 minute or until mixture is fragrant.
Add tomato, couscous, peas, stock and 1 cup (250ml) water; bring to the boil.
Reduce heat to low; cook, covered, for 7 minutes or until liquid is absorbed.
Top couscous 'kedgeree' with halved eggs and reserved coriander leaves; season to taste.

recipes.name: Chocolate mud cake
ingredients: silver cachous or dragée cake decorations, optional
sentences: Preheat the oven to moderate (180°C/160°C fan-forced).
Grease a deep 19cm square cake pan, line base and sides with baking paper.
Bake in a moderate oven for about 1 hour 15 minutes or until firm to touch.
Stand cake in pan for 5 minutes; turn top-side up onto a wire rack to cool.
